reena: For the one-pager let's show explicit SLAs. Ops recommended: Hosted 99.9% uptime / P95 <= 120ms (1k tokens); Dedicated 99.95% / P95 <= 80ms; Private SLA = negotiable (customer infra).

matt: I'll write the 300w post and the 60w social blurb. Also add a 50-75w benchmark callout comparing p95 and cost delta per 1k tokens. Need perf CSV from eng.

ida: Eng note: Dedicated numbers assume reserved 8xA100 pools and throughput batching; Hosted uses mixed-precision variants. I'll drop a short measurement note.

sam: Sales bullets for the field: 1) Predictable SLA & cost, 2) Data tenancy + KMS/HSM, 3) Same API across modes, 4) Migration + fallback path. Keep it one column.

reena: Webinar hook: "Compliant LLMs: Latency, Cost, and Controls"  30-min demo: Dedicated + auto-failover to Hosted, quick Q&A. CTA: request compliance checklist.

matt: Inbound routing (SDR rules, pseudo): if form includes keywords "on-prem" or "data residency" -> route to AE_enterprise; else if annual_tokens > 50M -> route to AE_enterprise; else -> PS_queue. I'll add a tiny HubSpot snippet in assets.

ida: Linking perf files: /shared/perf/reg_launch_q4.csv and /shared/perf/dedicated_q4.csv. Ops-bot please confirm.

ops-bot: Reminder: upload perf CSVs to /shared/perf/reg_launch_q4.csv and /shared/perf/dedicated_q4.csv.
